evidence: CVE.org API https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-22754 has cveMetadata.state=PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn). CNA text: XML <sec:intercept-url servlet-path=... pattern=...> omits the servlet path from path matching so authorization rules are not exercised; affected Spring Security 7.0.0 through 7.0.4.

Vendor advisory https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-22754 (HIGH, 2026-04-20) restates the authorization bypass, lists 7.0.0-7.0.4 as affected, 7.0.5 OSS as the fix, and states 6.x and earlier are not affected. GHSA-4vrc-j85c-598c withdrawn_at is null.

At tag 7.0.4 (9bd793ffe65082f36305f6e285643fbb28f926e3), AuthorizationFilterParser.java:141-162 reads intercept-url attribute servlet-path and passes it to MatcherType.createMatcher. MatcherType.java:53-61 for MatcherType.path constructs PathPatternRequestMatcherFactoryBean and sets property basePath to that servlet path. PathPatternRequestMatcherFactoryBean.java:50-53 getObject() builds the matcher from this.builder; afterPropertiesSet at 70-74 calls this.builder.basePath(this.basePath) without assigning the return.

At the same tag, PathPatternRequestMatcher.java:243-248 Builder.basePath returns new Builder(this.parser, basePath) and does not mutate this. Builder.matcher at 318-324 concatenates this.basePath + path into the PathPattern used by matches()/matcher(HttpServletRequest). Discarding the returned builder therefore leaves basePath empty, so a request under the declared servlet path misses the intended authorization matcher and a later permissive rule can authorize it. Fix tests in 53bcf0d16b414d9f0436ac178c211ca6b9520d8e assert GET /spring/path is 403 and GET /path is 200 for servlet-path=/spring pattern=/path denyAll plus /** permitAll.

Tag 6.5.11 (73b077790fcb04ac3712033d3e939daf42264545) has no PathPatternRequestMatcherFactoryBean; MatcherType still applies servletPath via MvcRequestMatcher.setServletPath, matching the vendor 6.x-unaffected claim.
